title: Landing page clarity: match the promise to the next step
seoTitle: Landing page clarity and conversion paths | Faraz Ansari
description: Review a landing page using a promise, proof and action framework. Align campaign intent, page content and the next step without relying on vanity metrics.
deck: A practical promise-proof-action review for the moments between a campaign click, the page someone sees and the action they are asked to take.
heroAlt: Conceptual illustration of a campaign card connected to a landing page and a form, with a separate crossed-out detour
heroCaption: One coherent journey: promise, evidence and a clear next step.
context: Public educational framework based on independently published guidance. All examples are hypothetical; no employer campaigns, account data or measured outcomes are disclosed.
